# FG-REPO-0026

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 404 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_unreadable_spec_repository_is_spec_repository_unavailable` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 参照している仕様のリポジトリが見つからないか、あなたには読む権限がありません。パスを確かめるか、そのリポジトリの管理者に読む権限を依頼してください。
- en: The referenced specification repository was not found, or you may not read it. Check the path, or ask its maintainers for read access.
- id: Repositori spesifikasi yang dirujuk tidak ditemukan, atau Anda tidak berhak membacanya. Periksa jalurnya, atau minta akses baca kepada pengelolanya.

## 原因 (cause)

`GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/repository/spec-refs` (M3 X1): an entry `repo: <path>` could not be followed for this reader. Every case answers the same (`status: "unavailable"`, `error_code`, no project id, no version) so the answer is no existence oracle: nothing lives at the path, the path is a group or a user, the path is a moved or deleted tombstone (a pinned reference is not redirected: update the path), authorize() refused SpecRefRead on the project for the reader's own permissions (not visible, a service account that is not a member, pending deletion, a token without read_api), or the reader may read it but its repository is still provisioning. Each lookup costs the same statements whatever the outcome (NamespaceResolver contract). The other entries are still resolved.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event `forge.spec_refs.unresolved` (info) carries `error_code`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `line` and `reason`: absent, not_a_project, moved, tombstone_deleted, denied (with `decision_error_code`: the code authorize() gave — FG-REPO-0005, FG-REPO-0006, FG-AUTH-0002, …) or not_ready (with `referenced_project_id`). Never the path itself. For denied: check the reader's membership of the referenced project (gstn member list --project <id>); for moved: GET /api/v1/namespaces/resolve?path=<path> shows the current path.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct `repo:` in .forge/repo.yml to the repository's current path, or give the readers Reporter on it (an internal project is readable by every signed-in person). A service account must be a member. Nothing to change on the server.
